info.name: Workora API - Enterprise HRMS & SaaS Suite
info.description:
# Workora API Postman Collection (v2.1)

Complete production-ready testing suite covering all 37 backend controllers and 250 endpoints of the **Workora** enterprise Human Resource Management System (HRMS) & SaaS platform.

### Authentication & Roles
- **SuperAdmin**: Platform owner (`admin@workora.com` / `Admin@123`)
- **Tenant Admin / HRAdmin**: HR manager (`hradmin@workora.com` / `Admin@123`)
- **Finance Manager**: Finance controller (`finance@workora.com` / `Admin@123`)
- **Employee ESS**: Standard workforce user (`employee@workora.com` / `Admin@123`)

### Variable Chaining
Authentication scripts automatically capture `accessToken` and `refreshToken`. Creation endpoints automatically store created resource IDs (`employeeId`, `departmentId`, `designationId`, `shiftId`, `leaveRequestId`, `payrollRunId`, `candidateId`, `jobOfferId`, etc.) for seamless sequential execution.
